name: editable-section
title: Editable section
description: View or edit a group of details in place: a summary with an Edit button turns into fields with Save and Cancel, and focus returns when done.
docs: Pass the facts as view (a DescriptionList is made for it) and the fields as children, each with a name. Edit swaps one for the other and moves focus to the first field; Escape cancels and focus lands on the Edit button; Save returns there too, after a polite "Saved". onSave gets the FormData and may return a promise: the fields and Cancel lock while it runs, the save button says it is busy, and a rejection keeps the form open with the message in an alert and everything as typed. Changed fields make Cancel and Escape ask "Discard changes?" in place; dirty overrides the automatic check. editing, defaultEditing and onEditingChange control it, and disabled switches the Edit button off so that other sections wait while one is open. The edit form is a real form: do not put the section inside another one. The Edit button is named "Edit" plus the title.
